text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates bus service on Petrolia Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking at all times on both sides of Petrolia Road, between Steeles Avenue West and Limestone Crescent. Currently parking is permitted for a maximum of three hours on both sides of the street. The parking prohibition will address concerns with parked vehicles, which may reduce sightlines at the numerous driveways of the local businesses, as well as impede the heavy trucks that are making frequent deliveries on this street.
City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit parking at all times on both sides of Petrolia Road, between Steeles Avenue West and Limestone Crescent.
